_comment: V5 M9a (I9a.3): the run checks' config margins (owner-editable; read by plausibility.mjs). Every bound is max(config margin, p99.9 of the strongest personality's simulated voyages x multiplier). The margins here are floors for the per-minute and run-total bounds, the tolerances of the consistency rules, and the simulator settings. They are not gameplay config, so changing them does not move the game's config hash; regenerate the rules after any change (node plausibility.mjs).
